review_notes: Read the whole file, plus cubeAverage/cubeVolume/cubeSet definitions in the same library and Mathlib's ProbabilityTheory.cond and MeasureTheory.average. cubeMeasure, cubeLpNorm, cubeW1p* and cubeFluctuation are named specialisations or have no Mathlib counterpart, so I did not report them. cubeAverage (defined in CubeAverage.lean, outside the target) is also a bespoke version of Mathlib's set average, but I did not make it a finding because it is not in this file. Uncertainty: I did not check whether `cond` matches `normalizedCubeMeasure` definitionally. The two use `(μ s)⁻¹` in ℝ≥0∞ versus `ofReal (cubeVolume Q)⁻¹`, and they are provably equal because `cubeMeasure_apply_univ_eq` gives `μ s = ofReal vol`. The proposed replacement has not been compiled.

findings.problem: `normalizedCubeMeasure Q` is the volume-normalised restriction of Lebesgue measure to `cubeSet Q`. That is exactly Mathlib's conditional measure `ProbabilityTheory.cond MeasureTheory.volume (cubeSet Q)`, i.e. `volume[|cubeSet Q]`, defined as `(μ s)⁻¹ • μ.restrict s`. The file builds a parallel definition and re-proves the basic API by hand. `cubeMeasure_apply_univ_ne_top`, `cubeMeasure_apply_univ_eq`, `normalizedCubeMeasure_apply_univ` (analogue of `cond_apply_self`) and `normalizedCubeMeasure_ne_zero` (analogue of the `IsProbabilityMeasure` instance) are all hand-proved. The file registers only `IsFiniteMeasure`, not `IsProbabilityMeasure`, even though the measure has total mass 1. As a result, Mathlib's probability-measure API does not apply. The lemma `hreal_univ : (normalizedCubeMeasure Q).real Set.univ = 1` is re-derived by hand twice (in `cubeAverage_sub_const_of_memLp_two` and `cubeAverage_cubeFluctuation`), instead of using `measureReal_univ_eq_one`. The file also never uses Mathlib's `⨍` average notation.
findings.proposed_change: Prove `normalizedCubeMeasure Q = MeasureTheory.volume[|cubeSet Q]` once, using `cubeMeasure_apply_univ_eq`, or redefine `normalizedCubeMeasure Q := ProbabilityTheory.cond MeasureTheory.volume (cubeSet Q)` and keep the name as a notation-level abbreviation. Supply `IsProbabilityMeasure (normalizedCubeMeasure Q)` through `ProbabilityTheory.cond_isProbabilityMeasure_of_finite`, using that the cube volume is nonzero and finite. This replaces `IsFiniteMeasure`, which then follows automatically. Delete the manual `normalizedCubeMeasure_apply_univ` and `normalizedCubeMeasure_ne_zero` proofs, or derive them from the instance. Replace the two `hreal_univ` blocks with `measureReal_univ_eq_one` or `simp`. Optionally state `cubeAverage Q f = ⨍ x in cubeSet Q, f x` via `MeasureTheory.setAverage_eq`.
findings.benefit: Removes duplicated measure-normalisation API. Makes the cube measure a standard probability measure, so Mathlib lemmas for `cond`, `average` and probability-measure `Lp` norms apply without conversions. Shortens proofs that currently re-derive that the total mass is 1.
